annotations.title: Tax audit register and 60-audit cap tracker: each partner's count against the ICAI 2025 limit, the firm's capacity, what counts and why (signed)

description: Tax-audit assignment register and 60-audit cap tracker for Indian chartered accountant firms (ICAI). Send the financial year, the partners (codes, full-time or part-time, counted reports signed elsewhere) and the tax audit assignments (ref, client code, assessment year, UDIN sub-category, who signs, date signed or none yet, revised). Get back the register with each assignment counted or not and why, each partner's count against 60, what is left, what the planned ones would do, the firm's capacity (60 per full-time partner), issues marked fix or check, and a signed record. Rule: The Chartered Accountants (Limit on Number of Tax Audits) Guidelines, 2025 (ICAI F. No. 1-CA(7)/234/2025, in force 1 Apr 2026) and the ICAI UDIN ceiling FAQs, read 16 Nov 2026. Codes only: names, PAN, membership numbers and UDINs are refused. It does not decide whether an audit is required, does not read the UDIN portal and is not professional advice. One of LLPRO's regulatory-trust checks: dated, signed, sources named. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/tax-audit-assignment-register-and). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: Today's date for this register, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in India). Signing dates after it are refused as errors in the register.

assignments.description: The firm's tax audit assignments for the year, signed or accepted and not yet signed. Codes only. Up to 200 per call.

assessment_year.description: Assessment year of the audit, YYYY-YY, e.g. 2026-27.

category.description: UDIN sub-category: 3CA_proviso3, 3CB_44AB_a, 3CB_44AB_b, 3CB_combined (these count), or 3CB_44AB_c, 3CB_44AB_d, 3CB_44AB_e (presumptive cases under 44AE, 44ADA, 44AD: never counted).

client.description: Your code for the auditee (the same code for its head office and branches). No names or PAN.

ref.description: Your reference for this assignment, e.g. TA-014.

revised.description: true for a revised tax audit report (never counted: para 11).

signed_by.description: Code of the partner who signs (or signed) the report; must be in partners.

signed_on.description: Date the report was signed, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out if accepted and not yet signed (it is then counted as planned).

financial_year.description: The financial year whose signed reports are counted, YYYY-YY (2026-27 or later: the 2025 Guidelines apply from 1 Apr 2026). A report counts in the year it is signed.

partners.description: Every partner of the firm (or the one member, for a proprietor or a member practising alone). Codes only.

code.description: Your code for the partner, e.g. P1. No names or membership numbers.

practice.description: full_time, or part_time (a part-time practising partner adds nothing to the firm's capacity: para 12.5).

signed_elsewhere.description: Counted tax audit reports this partner signed in this financial year in another firm or in their own name (from their own record or the UDIN portal count). They count against the same 60 (paras 8, 9).
